Name: Lumisteria More Flowery Grass
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is a content pack for the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398]More Grass[/url]" Mod.
It adds a lot of flowery grass in spring, summer, and fall.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/562403895637442560/678709677315457024/unknown.png[/img]
(The character hat is coming from "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2855]Seasonal Hats[/url]")

If you want a dense effect, i suggest you to rename "exampleconfig.json" currently included in the mod to "config.json".
